canonicalState: Keep original VM objects and arrays. Capture position/velocity references once, retain whole-vector identity, and reload velocity[0] after both position writes.
requiredGuard: No Proxy/host object/accessor/coercing property reads; position, velocity and direction must be actual own ordinary data properties.
position/velocity must be dense plain Number arrays with actual own 0/1 slots; position slots writable.
direction must be a writable Number property, even if its write branch is not eventually taken, or use a separate no-write proof.
All inputs including dt finite; preserve ordered multiplication then addition without FMA or algebraic reassociation.
Guard current MXCSR; source fallback executes before any observable mutation if any guard fails.
No allocation, JS callback, GC safepoint, descriptor/prototype changes or reentrancy while borrowing storage; re-resolve after any such boundary.
Use the pinned VM encoding and GC-aware write helpers. Passing copied double bits into Rust is a scalar bridge, not a zero-copy canonical-slot borrow.
finiteInputProof: Finite vector components and finite dt produce finite or infinite deltas; adding a finite old component cannot produce NaN. Direction negation is finite. The comparison may transiently produce NaN after overflow times zero, but stores no NaN. This narrow guard avoids VM-specific NaN array-store policy without changing it.
implementationStatus: Reviewed integration contract; no unused raw-slot Rust abstraction added. Existing Vec2Arena update is the alias-preserving arithmetic reference, not canonical VM integration.
